blocks.zh: 第一章：緒論
blocks.en: Chapter 1: Introduction

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）的基本定義：從液體中去除微生物，同時不影響產品品質
blocks.en: Understand the basic definition of sterilizing filtration: removing microorganisms from a liquid without affecting product quality

blocks.zh: 了解 PDA TR 26 技術報告的歷史沿革（1998 → 2008 → 2025），以及每次修訂的驅動因素
blocks.en: Learn the history of PDA TR 26 (1998 → 2008 → 2025) and what drove each revision

blocks.zh: 認識除菌級濾膜從 0.45 µm 演進到 0.2/0.22 µm 的關鍵歷史事件 — Dr. Frances Bowman 的 FDA 發現
blocks.en: Recognize the key historical event behind the shift from 0.45 µm to 0.2/0.22 µm sterilizing-grade filters: Dr. Frances Bowman's FDA finding

blocks.zh: 掌握 ASTM F838 標準測試方法的由來與意義
blocks.en: Understand the origin and significance of the ASTM F838 standard test method

blocks.zh: 理解 TR 26 修訂版的定位：科學指導文件，非強制性標準
blocks.en: Understand the positioning of the revised TR 26: a scientific guidance document, not a mandatory standard

blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Sterilizing Filtration（除菌過濾）：指透過過濾方式從液體中去除微生物，使濾出液達到無菌狀態的製程。這裡有兩個關鍵要素：
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filtration: a process that removes microorganisms from a liquid by filtration so that the filtrate is sterile. Two elements are key here:

blocks.zh: 去除微生物 — 不是殺死微生物（那是滅菌 Sterilization），而是物理性地將它們截留在濾膜上游
blocks.en: Removing microorganisms — this is not killing them (that is sterilization); the microorganisms are physically retained on the upstream side of the membrane

blocks.zh: 不影響產品品質 — 這點經常被忽略。除菌過濾不能改變藥品的有效成分、濃度、pH 值或其他關鍵品質屬性（CQA）
blocks.en: Not affecting product quality — this point is often overlooked. Sterilizing filtration must not change the active ingredient, concentration, pH or other critical quality attributes (CQAs) of the drug product

blocks.zh: Sterilizing-Grade Filter（除菌級濾膜）：通過 ASTM F838 標準測試的濾膜，能夠在標準條件下完全截留挑戰菌 Brevundimonas diminuta（每 cm² 至少 107 CFU）。
blocks.en: Sterilizing-Grade Filter: a filter that passes the ASTM F838 test and is able to completely retain the challenge organism Brevundimonas diminuta (at least 107 CFU per cm²) under standard conditions.

blocks.zh: ASTM F838：美國材料與試驗學會發布的標準測試方法，用於評估除菌級濾膜的細菌截留（Bacterial Retention）能力。這是全球公認的除菌級濾膜鑑定標準。
blocks.en: ASTM F838: a standard test method published by ASTM International (American Society for Testing and Materials) to evaluate the bacterial retention capability of sterilizing-grade filters. It is the globally recognized standard for qualifying sterilizing-grade filters.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 淨水器的升級故事：
blocks.en: The water purifier upgrade story:

blocks.zh: 想像你家裡的淨水器。最早大家用的濾芯（0.45 µm）能過濾掉大部分雜質，大家都覺得很安心。直到有一天，一位檢驗員（Dr. Bowman）發現，某些特別小的細菌竟然能從濾芯的縫隙中「溜過去」 — 尤其當水中細菌數量很多的時候。
blocks.en: Imagine the water purifier at home. The earliest filter cartridges (0.45 µm) removed most impurities, and everyone felt reassured. Then one day an inspector (Dr. Bowman) found that some especially small bacteria could "slip through" the gaps in the cartridge, particularly when the water carried a high bacterial load.

blocks.zh: 這個發現震驚了整個產業，就像發現你的門鎖其實擋不住小偷一樣。於是大家開始開發更細密的濾芯（0.2 µm），並制定了嚴格的「防盜測試標準」（ASTM F838）來確保新濾芯真的安全。
blocks.en: This finding shocked the whole industry, like discovering that your door lock cannot actually stop a burglar. People then began developing finer cartridges (0.2 µm) and set a strict "burglar-proof test standard" (ASTM F838) to make sure the new cartridges were truly safe.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾 ≠ 除病毒過濾：原文特別以腳註標示 — 除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）的目的是去除細菌等微生物，不包含病毒。病毒的尺寸（20-300 nm）遠小於除菌級濾膜的孔徑（0.2 µm = 200 nm），因此病毒去除需要使用專門的病毒過濾器（Virus Retentive Filter），通常孔徑為 20 nm 或 50 nm。
blocks.en: Sterilizing filtration ≠ virus removal filtration: the original text points out in a footnote that the purpose of sterilizing filtration is to remove bacteria and other microorganisms, and that it does not include viruses. Viruses (20-300 nm) are far smaller than the pore size of a sterilizing-grade filter (0.2 µm = 200 nm), so virus removal requires a dedicated virus-retentive filter, typically with a pore size of 20 nm or 50 nm.

blocks.zh: 歷史分水嶺：1960 年 Dr. Bowman 的發現是製藥過濾史上最關鍵的轉折點。它證明了「通過標準測試」不等於「在所有條件下都能除菌」，這個教訓至今仍是除菌過濾驗證的核心原則。
blocks.en: Historical turning point: Dr. Bowman's finding in 1960 was the most pivotal turning point in the history of pharmaceutical filtration. It showed that "passing a standard test" does not mean "achieving sterility under all conditions", a lesson that remains a core principle of sterilizing filtration validation today.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼除菌過濾的定義中要特別強調「不影響產品品質」？如果一個過濾器能 100% 截留細菌但會吸附 30% 的活性成分，它能被稱為合適的除菌過濾器嗎？
blocks.en: Why does the definition of sterilizing filtration specifically stress "not affecting product quality"? If a filter retains 100% of bacteria but adsorbs 30% of the active ingredient, can it be called a suitable sterilizing filter?

blocks.zh: Dr. Bowman 在 1960 年的發現，為什麼能從根本上改變整個產業對除菌過濾的認知？如果今天在你的 CDMO 工廠發現類似問題，應該啟動什麼流程？
blocks.en: Why did Dr. Bowman's 1960 finding fundamentally change the whole industry's understanding of sterilizing filtration? If you found a similar problem at your CDMO site today, what process should you initiate?

blocks.zh: TR 26 明確表示它不是「強制性標準」，那為什麼幾乎所有製藥公司都會參考它？想想技術報告與法規之間的關係。
blocks.en: TR 26 clearly states that it is not a "mandatory standard", so why do almost all pharmaceutical companies refer to it? Think about the relationship between technical reports and regulations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 TR 26 版本演進
blocks.en: Key Notes: TR 26 Version History

blocks.zh: 每次修訂都是被產業實踐與法規變化所驅動的 — 這說明除菌過濾是一個持續演進的領域，不是「學一次就夠了」的知識。
blocks.en: Each revision was driven by industry practice and regulatory change, which shows that sterilizing filtration is a continuously evolving field, not knowledge you learn once and are done with.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose & Scope — 目的與範圍
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose & Scope

blocks.zh: 科學指導 vs 強制標準：TR 26 的定位是「科學技術報告」（Scientific Technical Report），而非法規要求。這意味著：
blocks.en: Scientific guidance vs mandatory standard: TR 26 is positioned as a "Scientific Technical Report", not a regulatory requirement. This means:

blocks.zh: 指導性 — 提供基於科學的建議和最佳實務
blocks.en: Guidance — it provides science-based recommendations and best practices

blocks.zh: 非強制性 — 不是法律要求，企業可以根據自身情況調整
blocks.en: Non-mandatory — it is not a legal requirement, and companies may adapt it to their own circumstances

blocks.zh: 全球適用 — 不針對特定國家或地區的法規，而是建立通用的科學原則
blocks.en: Global applicability — it is not aimed at the regulations of any particular country or region but establishes general scientific principles

blocks.zh: Bioburden Reduction（生物負載降低）：原文特別指出 TR 26 的內容主要適用於「除菌過濾」製程，不一定適用於上游的生物負載降低步驟。這是兩個不同等級的過濾目的。
blocks.en: Bioburden Reduction: the original text specifically notes that the content of TR 26 mainly applies to the "sterilizing filtration" process and does not necessarily apply to upstream bioburden reduction steps. These are two different levels of filtration purpose.

blocks.zh: 米其林指南 vs 衛生法規：
blocks.en: Michelin Guide vs health regulations:

blocks.zh: TR 26 就像製藥界的「米其林指南」— 它代表業界最高的專業共識和最佳實務建議，所有優秀的餐廳（製藥公司）都會參考它來提升自己的水準。但它不是「餐飲衛生法規」（如 FDA 法規或 EU GMP Annex 1）— 法規才是有法律約束力的強制要求。
blocks.en: TR 26 is like the "Michelin Guide" of the pharmaceutical world: it represents the industry's highest professional consensus and best-practice recommendations, and all outstanding restaurants (pharmaceutical companies) refer to it to raise their own standards. But it is not a "food hygiene regulation" (such as FDA regulations or EU GMP Annex 1); regulations are the legally binding mandatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 然而實務上，當法規稽查員來查廠時，如果你的做法嚴重偏離 TR 26 的建議，你最好能提出科學合理的解釋。因為稽查員也會參考這些業界共識文件。
blocks.en: In practice, however, when a regulatory inspector visits your site and your practice deviates seriously from the recommendations of TR 26, you had better be able to give a scientifically sound justification, because inspectors also refer to these industry consensus documents.

blocks.zh: 全球視角的重要性：2025 年修訂版的撰寫團隊涵蓋了歐洲和北美的產業專家，並且接受了來自美洲、亞太和歐洲專家的審查。這種全球化的審核流程確保了內容的普適性。
blocks.en: The importance of a global perspective: the author team of the 2025 revision included industry experts from Europe and North America, and the document was reviewed by experts from the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Europe. This global review process ensures the content is broadly applicable.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的意義：作為承接全球客戶訂單的 CDMO，你需要同時滿足 FDA（美國）、EMA（歐洲）、PMDA（日本）、NMPA（中國）等不同法規體系的要求。TR 26 提供的正是這種跨法規體系的科學基礎，讓你在建立除菌過濾政策時有一個公認的起點。
blocks.en: Significance for CDMOs: as a CDMO taking orders from customers worldwide, you must meet the requirements of different regulatory systems at the same time, such as FDA (US), EMA (Europe), PMDA (Japan) and NMPA (China). TR 26 provides the scientific basis that spans these systems, giving you a recognized starting point when establishing your sterilizing filtration policy.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：假設一家歐洲客戶要求你的除菌過濾驗證策略必須「符合 TR 26 最新版本」，而另一家美國客戶則要求「符合 FDA Guidance on Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing」。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: suppose a European customer requires your sterilizing filtration validation strategy to "comply with the latest version of TR 26", while a US customer requires "compliance with the FDA Guidance on Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing".

blocks.zh: 你不需要建立兩套完全不同的系統 — TR 26 的科學原則與 FDA 指南高度一致。你的策略應該是：以 TR 26 的科學框架為基礎，再根據各法規的特殊要求進行補充和調整。
blocks.en: You do not need to build two completely different systems, because the scientific principles of TR 26 are highly consistent with the FDA guidance. Your strategy should be to use the TR 26 scientific framework as the foundation and then add to or adjust it for the specific requirements of each regulation.

blocks.zh: TR 26 的定位是「科學指導」而非「強制標準」，但在實際稽查中，如果你的做法與 TR 26 建議不一致，可能會面臨什麼情況？你會如何應對？
blocks.en: TR 26 is positioned as "scientific guidance" rather than a "mandatory standard", but in an actual inspection, what could happen if your practice is inconsistent with the TR 26 recommendations? How would you respond?

blocks.zh: 原文提到 TR 26 不適用於「上游生物負載降低步驟」。請說明除菌過濾與生物負載降低過濾在目的、驗證要求和濾膜選擇上有什麼不同？
blocks.en: The original text states that TR 26 does not apply to "upstream bioburden reduction steps". Explain how sterilizing filtration and bioburden reduction filtration differ in purpose, validation requirements and filter selection.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，同時承接多國客戶的專案，為什麼擁有一份基於 TR 26 的通用除菌過濾政策比針對每個客戶建立獨立政策更有效率？
blocks.en: As a CDMO taking on projects from customers in many countries, why is having a common sterilizing filtration policy based on TR 26 more efficient than building a separate policy for each customer?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）的核心定義：從液體中去除微生物，同時不得影響產品品質 — 這兩個要素缺一不可
blocks.en: Sterilizing filtration is defined by its core elements: removing microorganisms from a liquid without affecting product quality. Both elements are indispensable

blocks.zh: 歷史轉折點：1960 年 Dr. Bowman 發現 0.45 µm 濾膜無法完全截留所有微生物，促成了 ASTM F838 標準的建立，以及從 0.45 µm 到 0.2/0.22 µm 孔徑評級（Pore Size Rating）的產業轉型
blocks.en: Historical turning point: in 1960 Dr. Bowman found that 0.45 µm filters could not completely retain all microorganisms, which led to the establishment of ASTM F838 and the industry shift from 0.45 µm to 0.2/0.22 µm pore size ratings

blocks.zh: TR 26 的定位：全球公認的科學技術報告（非強制標準），提供除菌過濾的選擇、驗證與使用的系統性方法
blocks.en: Positioning of TR 26: a globally recognized scientific technical report (not a mandatory standard) that provides a systematic approach to the selection, validation and use of sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: 2025 年修訂重點：反映當前最佳實務與法規期望，特別釐清了濾膜供應商與終端使用者的角色劃分
blocks.en: Key points of the 2025 revision: it reflects current best practice and regulatory expectations, and in particular clarifies the division of roles between filter suppliers and end users

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略：以 TR 26 的科學框架為基礎建立通用除菌過濾政策，再根據不同法規市場的特殊要求進行調整
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: build a common sterilizing filtration policy on the TR 26 scientific framework, then adjust it for the specific requirements of each regulatory market
